purpose: Source-triggered, immutable full-method planning floors for the current club scope. Independent of any --duration-profile supplied records, plan keys, observations or estimates. Unmeasured planning assumptions; not runtime upper bounds.

historical_source.basis: Exact frozen pre-club source; historical method/helper bytes are independently pinned by source projections. Absence of the new class alone never grants this exception.

ClubProfileScopeFlowTests.testAdminDispl.basis: Entire setup/launch, explicit waits, bounded reveal loop source envelopes, input/queries/animations, failure evidence and teardown. Not a measured runtime or a hard execution upper bound. Three seconds per swipe/query iteration and ninety seconds other overhead are engineering assumptions authorized for local planning.
